data.name: About_AnswerDeleteProfile
data.value: For a regular profile, only the profile entry and its workspace with profile settings, logs, and saves are deleted. Game and mod folders are not affected. A standalone profile's build folder also remains in place.

data.name: About_AnswerModOrder
data.value: Mods lower in the list have higher priority and can replace files from mods above them. This is the normal way to install a patch over a main mod. Change the order by dragging or with the buttons in the mod row. On the next launch, Workspace rebuilds the environment, while USVFS creates a virtual overlay in the new order.

data.name: About_AnswerRemoveMod
data.value: Yes. Remove only excludes the mod from this profile. The original mod folder remains untouched on disk.

data.name: About_AnswerSavesAndLogs
data.value: For a regular profile they are stored in workspace\userdata, so saves from different profiles do not mix. For a standalone build, its fsgame.ltx determines the location: the launcher finds common folders but cannot guarantee separate saves for each such build. The Status button shows the detected saves and latest log.

data.name: About_AnswerStartFailure
data.value: Open Status to see path checks, the selected EXE, latest log, and crash dump. First make sure every folder exists and that the EXE belongs to the game or an enabled mod. For the original Shadow of Chernobyl this is usually bin\XR_3DA.exe; for OGSR builds it is often bin_x64\xrEngine.exe.

data.name: About_AnswerWorkspaceSize
data.value: File Explorer counts files linked into the workspace as if each one were a separate copy there. In reality, a hard link does not duplicate data on disk. The Status window shows both the size visible to the game and the approximate occupied space.

data.name: About_BrowserBody
data.value: The Mod Browser button opens the AP-PRO catalog for Shadow of Chernobyl, Clear Sky, and Call of Pripyat. Selecting a card opens the mod's source page in your browser. The launcher does not download or install mods from this catalog.

data.name: About_CreateBody
data.value: Select Create, enter a name, and choose the profile type. For a profile based on a game, select its folder and add mods in priority order. For a ready-made separate build, select Standalone build and choose its root folder. The wizard tries to find a suitable EXE; you can select it manually in Settings if necessary.

data.name: About_DisclaimerBody
data.value: This is an unofficial fan-made tool. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by GSC Game World. S.T.A.L.K.E.R. and related trademarks belong to their respective owners.

data.name: About_LaunchModesBody
data.value: Workspace prepares the environment in advance using file-system links. USVFS overlays the same layers virtually using Mod Organizer 2 technology and uses almost no space for game files. USVFS compatibility depends on the game and launch method; select Workspace in profile settings if you encounter problems.

data.name: About_Mo2Body
data.value: The MO2 button transfers an existing game profile: mod order and enabled state, as well as detected base-game and overwrite folders. The source Mod Organizer 2, game, and mod directories are not changed.

data.name: About_ProfileBody
data.value: A profile is a saved configuration of one game setup: the base game, enabled mods, their order, launch arguments, and selected EXE. You can create multiple profiles for one game and switch between them without changing the original game and mod folders.

data.name: About_RegularStandaloneBody
data.value: A regular profile adds mods on top of a base game and creates a separate environment for launching it. A standalone profile is for a ready-made build with its own engine and runs from its own folder; it does not require a base game.

data.name: About_WorkspaceBody
data.value: Workspace is a separate folder where the launcher combines the game and enabled mods for a regular profile. Large source files are connected with links, so the entire game is not copied for every profile. All changes, profile settings, logs, and saves stay inside this environment; the original game is not modified.
